author: Veritas I
title: Task-Specific Head CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention
abstract: This submission refines the hybrid CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention architecture by implementing task-specific prediction heads. After the shared feature extraction (CNN, BiLSTM, Additive Attention Pooling), the model branches into separate dense layer pathways for each unique task type (regression, multi-label classification, multi-label regression, multi-class classification). This allows specialized learning for each prediction problem, aiming to achieve more balanced and improved performance across all seven diverse RNA datasets.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict

# Additive Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class AdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int # Hidden units for the attention scoring mechanism

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        
        # Compute attention scores
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name="attention_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)
        
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply attention weights to original sequence and sum
        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1) # (batch, input_features)
        
        return pooled_output

# Main network class with task-specific heads
class TaskSpecificHeadCNNBiLSTMNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    conv_features: int = 192
    kernel_size: int = 9
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 384
    attention_dense_units: int = 192
    
    # Task-specific dense layer dimensions
    regression_dense_dim: int = 512
    multilabel_clf_dense_dim: int = 512
    multilabel_reg_dense_dim: int = 512
    multiclass_clf_dense_dim: int = 512

    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # 1. CNN Layer for local feature extraction (shared)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling (shared)
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) # (batch, new_seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 3. Additive Self-Attention Pooling to get fixed-size representation (shared)
        x = AdditiveAttentionPooling(dense_attn_units=self.attention_dense_units)(x) # (batch, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 4. Task-Specific Dense Layers and Output Heads
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(self.regression_dense_dim, name="regression_dense_1")(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
            x = nn.Dense(1, name="regression_output")(x)
            return x.squeeze(-1)
        elif self.task_type == "multilabel_classification":
            x = nn.Dense(self.multilabel_clf_dense_dim, name="multilabel_clf_dense_1")(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name="multilabel_clf_output")(x)
            return x
        elif self.task_type == "multilabel_regression":
            x = nn.Dense(self.multilabel_reg_dense_dim, name="multilabel_reg_dense_1")(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name="multilabel_reg_output")(x)
            return x
        elif self.task_type == "multiclass_classification":
            x = nn.Dense(self.multiclass_clf_dense_dim, name="multiclass_clf_dense_1")(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name="multiclass_clf_output")(x)
            return x
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown task_type: {self.task_type}")

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Task-Specific Head CNN-BiLSTM model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'conv_features': 192,
        'kernel_size': 9,
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 384,
        'attention_dense_units': 192,
        'regression_dense_dim': 512,
        'multilabel_clf_dense_dim': 512,
        'multilabel_reg_dense_dim': 512,
        'multiclass_clf_dense_dim': 512,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_TaskSpecificHeads:
    """Custom network wrapper for Task-Specific Head CNN-BiLSTM."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 conv_features=192, kernel_size=9,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=384, attention_dense_units=192,
                 regression_dense_dim=512, multilabel_clf_dense_dim=512,
                 multilabel_reg_dense_dim=512, multiclass_clf_dense_dim=512,
                 dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = TaskSpecificHeadCNNBiLSTMNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
            regression_dense_dim=regression_dense_dim,
            multilabel_clf_dense_dim=multilabel_clf_dense_dim,
            multilabel_reg_dense_dim=multilabel_reg_dense_dim,
            multiclass_clf_dense_dim=multiclass_clf_dense_dim,
            dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 192)
    kernel_size = hparams.get("kernel_size", 9)
    lstm_hidden_dim = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim", 384)
    attention_dense_units = hparams.get("attention_dense_units", 192)
    regression_dense_dim = hparams.get("regression_dense_dim", 512)
    multilabel_clf_dense_dim = hparams.get("multilabel_clf_dense_dim", 512)
    multilabel_reg_dense_dim = hparams.get("multilabel_reg_dense_dim", 512)
    multiclass_clf_dense_dim = hparams.get("multiclass_clf_dense_dim", 512)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_TaskSpecificHeads(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
        lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
        regression_dense_dim=regression_dense_dim,
        multilabel_clf_dense_dim=multilabel_clf_dense_dim,
        multilabel_reg_dense_dim=multilabel_reg_dense_dim,
        multiclass_clf_dense_dim=multiclass_clf_dense_dim,
        dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
